rpglevels.quest.abyssal_slayer.desc: Defeat 3 monsters of Rank C or higher in Deepslate.
rpglevels.quest.cultist_hunt.title: Rank A Mission: The Corrupted Reaper
rpglevels.quest.cultist_hunt.desc: Travel into the Abyss dimension and defeat the Cultist before the Demon race is revived.
item.rpglevels.escape_scroll.desc: Mystic parchment inscribed with dimensional return coordinates.
rpglevels.trial.blood_spilled: You have spilled blood for the first time. An unknown presence watches you as night falls...
rpglevels.trial.title: ✦ THE INTERDIMENSIONAL VOID ✦
rpglevels.trial.subtitle: An unknown presence observes you...
rpglevels.trial.dialogue_2: I sense the stench of blood on your hands. You have taken your first step as a warrior, but your flesh is still frail.
rpglevels.trial.dialogue_3: I bestow upon you the Warrior's Blessing, yet blessings are not gifted... they are seized in combat!
rpglevels.trial.ares_1: Magnificent! Your martial spirit blazes fiercely.
rpglevels.trial.ares_2: I am Ares, the God of War. From this day forth, the secrets of physical prowess are revealed to you.
rpglevels.trial.ares_3: You have obtained your first Physical Skill Point (+1)!
rpglevels.trial.ares_4: Open your Adventurer Sheet (H key or inventory) and consult the Physical Skill Tree to begin your martial path.
rpglevels.item.first_sword.name: First Sword
rpglevels.item.first_sword.lore_1: Relic of the God of War
rpglevels.item.first_sword.lore_2: Forged in the primordial fires of battle.
rpglevels.item.first_sword.lore_3: Bestows courage upon those who overcome their first trial.

rpglevels.abyss.rift_unavailable: Error: The Abyss Rift dimension is not available.
rpglevels.abyss.descended: ✦ You have descended into the Infinite Abyss. Venture deeper into the caves to face higher-ranked foes.

rpglevels.social.guard_tooltip: Order them to guard this spot.

rpglevels.spiritual_sword.title: ✦ Awakened Spiritual Blade
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.style_desc.fre: Consecutive hits stack Frenzy (+8% damage & speed per stack, max 5).
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.style_desc.due: +15% base damage and +40% counter-attack damage after blocking or parrying.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.style_desc.bul: Blocks 80% frontal damage and deploys a Mana Barrier when hit below 45% HP.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.style_desc.pha: Projects a vacuum wave extending your slash reach to 4.8 blocks.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.element_desc.n: Pure spiritual energy without elemental alteration.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.element_desc.i: Ignites targets (5s) and detonates solar embers.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.element_desc.f: Chains lightning to up to 3 nearby enemies and slows targets.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.element_desc.g: Freezes and heavily slows targets with crystalline frost.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.element_desc.u: Drains 12% health on hit and shrouds foes in abyssal darkness.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.resonance_desc: Channels your Spirit into every slash and restores Mana in combat.
Turns your vitality into heavy strikes that shatter enemy posture.
Sharpens lethal precision, boosting critical strike chance and damage.
Each strike can trigger a Jackpot of bonus damage, Mana, and XP.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.release_desc.s: [Sneak + Right-Click] Fires a piercing elemental crescent wave up to 9m.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.release_desc.v: [Sneak + Right-Click] Unleashes a 6m vortex that pulls and damages foes.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.release_desc.s: [Sneak + Right-Click] Instant shadow-step behind your target for a critical strike.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.release_desc.o: [Sneak + Right-Click] Doubles Resonance and Element effects for 12s.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.release_desc.j: [Sneak + Right-Click] Tears open a dimensional rift that suspends and slashes enemies.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.release_desc.b: [Sneak + Right-Click] Unleashes a cone of thousands of spiritual blades that shreds defenses.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.release_desc.d: [Sneak + Right-Click] Crushes enemies to the ground with overwhelming spiritual gravity.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.release_desc.p: [Sneak + Right-Click] Fires a dense piercing ray of spirit energy 25m forward.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.mana_repair_hi: ♾ Unbreakable Blade: Self-repairs using your Mana (2 MP = +2 Durability)
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.exhausted: Your Spiritual Blade is exhausted! Recover Mana to regenerate its edge.
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.no_mana: Not enough Mana to unleash your First Release! (Requires %s MP)
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.lore_1: «A living blade forged and awakened from
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.lore_2: the true name bestowed by its wielder.»
rpglevels.spiritual_sword.passive: ★ Spiritual Resonance: +0.35 Bonus Damage per Spirit point
rpglevels.gui.reputation_tooltip_desc.he: Beloved across the realm. Villagers offer massive discounts and adventurers revere you.
rpglevels.gui.reputation_tooltip_desc.ci: Respected and welcomed in civilized settlements. Reduced prices.
rpglevels.gui.reputation_tooltip_desc.ne: Standard common treatment. Your deeds have not yet tilted the moral scale.
rpglevels.gui.reputation_tooltip_desc.ou: Viewed with suspicion and distrust. Trade inflation due to criminal suspicion.
rpglevels.gui.reputation_tooltip_desc.pu: Wanted dead or alive! Villagers refuse trade and Iron Golems attack on sight.
rpglevels.reputation.refusal_public_enem: The villager flees in terror and refuses to trade with a Public Enemy!
rpglevels.reputation.reason.raid_victory: Hero of the Village: Raid repelled
rpglevels.worker.hire_tooltip: Hire this townswoman as a base worker.
rpglevels.worker.arrive_base_tooltip: Confirm arrival at base to receive the Overseer's Cane.
rpglevels.worker.edit_work_tooltip: Receive the Overseer's Cane to reconfigure work zone or chests.
rpglevels.worker.inventory_tooltip: Inspect worker's tool and gathered items.
rpglevels.worker.dismiss_tooltip: Dismiss and cancel the work contract with this NPC.
item.rpglevels.high_experience_bottle.de: ★ Grants 10x more experience than a normal bottle (30 to 110 XP).
item.rpglevels.high_experience_bottle.re: Crafted with 9 experience bottles on a crafting table.
spell.rpglevels.connect_realities.desc: Unleashes an abyssal shockwave that repels foes and ignites Crying Obsidian frames to awaken the Abyss Portal.
spell.rpglevels.summon_lesser_soul: Spiritual Technique Nº 7: Summon Lesser Soul
spell.rpglevels.summon_lesser_soul.desc: Permanently manifests your loyal spiritual companion (Pelotita). Faithfully follows you, heals party members, and grows stronger with your Spirit.
effect.rpglevels.abyssal_ward.descriptio: Grants complete immunity against the dimensional repulsion and void rejection of the Abyss.
spell.rpglevels.oppressive_aura.desc: Unleashes an imposing cylindrical column of spiritual pressure expanding outwards. All trapped creatures suffer the crushing gravity of your soul.
spell.rpglevels.spiritual_beam.desc: Universal Spiritual Sword technique. Unleashes a continuous Kamehameha-style beam capable of clashing with others in an epic Beam Clash.
ui.rpglevels.spiritual_beam.info2: Capable of clashing in Beam Clashes
ui.rpglevels.power_control.title: Power Control & Regulation
item.rpglevels.lesser_soul_crystal.desc: The crystallization of the purest and most fragile soul essence. Fundamental base for human metallurgy, forging alloys, and quenching.
item.rpglevels.resonant_soul_crystal.des: A pulsating prism charged with vital resonance. Capable of transmitting and magnifying mechanical strain in military-grade armaments.
item.rpglevels.radiant_soul_crystal.desc: A dazzling gem condensed under immense spiritual pressure. Empowers guild blacksmiths to forge edges that shear through magical barriers.
item.rpglevels.primordial_soul_crystal.d: The timeless vestige of a cataclysmic soul. The supreme core for crafting legendary armaments capable of defying spiritual gods.
